CapacityMode.Name: Default capacity mode
CapacityMode.Hint: How the inventory capacity is determined by default.

MaxContainers.Name: Maximum container zones
MaxContainers.Hint: How many carried containers get their own inventory zone. Minimum 1.

DefaultCols.Name: Fallback columns
DefaultCols.Hint: Legacy zones without a declared weight only. The main grid is always 10 columns.

DefaultRows.Name: Fallback rows
DefaultRows.Hint: Legacy zones without a declared weight only. Main rows come from weight / 4 lb.

DefaultMaxWeight.Name: Default max weight
DefaultMaxWeight.Hint: Carry capacity in lb. Each 4 lb is one space, so 300 lb gives 75 spaces.

Theme.Name: Inventory theme
Theme.Hint: Color theme for the inventory window.

Sounds.Name: Inventory sounds
Sounds.Hint: Play short sounds when equipping, placing, stacking or failing to place an item.

App.Title: ARPG Inventory
App.NeedContainer: You need a container to use {name}

OpenInventory.Name: Open ARPG Inventory
OpenInventory.Hint: Opens or closes the ARPG inventory window (default: B).
